run_pytorch_microbenchmark: run PyTorch microbenchmarks from a config file with warmup and iteration options
run_benchmark_with_profiling: run PyTorch benchmarks with Kineto profiler and Chrome trace export enabled
run_benchmark_with_ncu: run PyTorch benchmarks with NSight Compute to collect GPU metrics
run_benchmark_with_nsys: run PyTorch benchmarks with NSight Systems to collect system-level metrics
run_benchmark_with_cupti: run PyTorch benchmarks with CUPTI profiler to measure CUDA performance events
